description: Gantt Chart by CBT Convergent Business Technologies · Free · All features included Gantt Chart by CBT renders a hierarchical project schedule as an interactive Gantt view, pairing a resizable WBS grid with a dual baseline and actual timeline. Parent tasks automatically roll up dates, progress, and milestones from their children, so summary rows always reflect the work beneath them. This lets teams compare planned versus actual progress at every level of a schedule, with dependency arrows, pace tracking, and native conditional formatting surfacing risk before it becomes a problem. Key Capabilities Automatic Parent Rollups: Summary and phase rows compute their own baseline, actual, progress, and milestones live from their children, with no manual entry required. Dual Baseline and Actual Bars with Pace Tracking: Compare planned versus actual timelines at a glance, with a pace indicator showing whether a task is ahead, on track, or behind schedule. Configurable Milestones: Bind multiple milestone types per task, each with its own shape, size, and color, chosen from a real column picker. Dependency Arrows: Finish-to-start connector lines route automatically between tasks, with fan-out for multiple predecessors.
